scenes.name: 01-hook
scenes.caption:
“I can’t tell my family what I want without feeling ungrateful.”
Fictional · prepared scenario.

scenes.name: 02-audience-and-path
scenes.caption:
For people navigating family pressure: clarify privately,
correct the reflection, then decide whether to share.

scenes.name: 03-private-choice
scenes.caption:
He chooses a private first step.
No one else sees this reflection.

scenes.name: 04-own-words
scenes.caption:
Arjun puts the family pressure
into his own words.

scenes.name: 05-prepared-reflection-and-role
scenes.caption:
Muse Spark might suggest a theme; Arjun decides if it fits.
Prepared local example · no model connected.

scenes.name: 06-tentative-meaning
scenes.caption:
A possible meaning is offered
as something he can check.

scenes.name: 07-reject
scenes.caption:
He says “Not quite.”
The first interpretation does not stand.

scenes.name: 08-correction
scenes.caption:
He corrects it: he needs time
to decide for himself.

scenes.name: 09-changed-result
scenes.caption:
The editable reflection changes
to include his correction.

scenes.name: 10-confirmed-theme
scenes.caption:
He confirms the theme himself.
The product does not decide what is true.

scenes.name: 11-choice-to-explore
scenes.caption:
Only now does he choose
to hear other experiences.

scenes.name: 12-correction-changes-results
scenes.caption:
He sets aside broad legal results.
Family context stays in view.

scenes.name: 13-enter-community
scenes.caption:
He opens the family expectations
community preview.

scenes.name: 14-fiction-label
scenes.caption:
The community example is prepared
and fictional, not live.

scenes.name: 15-peer-perspective
scenes.caption:
Ravi names a different path: a trusted friend
helped him speak with family.

scenes.name: 16-shared-pressure
scenes.caption:
They share family pressure,
but the circumstances differ.

scenes.name: 17-different-support
scenes.caption:
Ravi had someone he trusted.
Arjun has not said he does.

scenes.name: 18-group-only
scenes.caption:
If Arjun asks, Ravi accepts questions
in the group only, never by DM.

scenes.name: 19-edited-question
scenes.caption:
He edits the question
to ask for time before answering.

scenes.name: 20-consent-boundary
scenes.caption:
Group and alias are shown.
Private reflection is excluded.

scenes.name: 21-cancel
scenes.caption:
He cancels.
Nothing is sent; the draft remains his.

scenes.name: 22-no-reply-yet
scenes.caption:
A later prepared thread has no reply yet.
A response is not promised.

scenes.name: 23-private-takeaway
scenes.caption:
Arjun keeps one takeaway privately
for this preview session.

scenes.name: 24-bounded-offer
scenes.caption:
He may offer one bounded thing
that helped to Dev’s example group.

scenes.name: 25-edit-and-review
scenes.caption:
He edits the exact contribution.
Consent remains unchecked until review.

scenes.name: 26-local-preview-added
scenes.caption:
He adds it to the fictional preview.
Nothing is sent to a real group or person.

checks.changedReflection: You want time to decide what you want, without someone choosing stay or leave for you.
checks.raviProvenance:
Illustrative experience · Ravi
Ravi

At first I asked everyone what I should do about my relationship. I got completely different answers. Some were kind, some felt like instructions. I stopped asking for a verdict and asked one trusted friend to listen while I worked out what mattered to me. I was still uncertain afterward, but I could hear my own thinking again.

One person's account, not a recommendation for your decision.
checks.difference:
WHERE YOUR LIVES DIFFER
What may not carry over
Ravi had an existing trusted friend, which Arjun has not said he has.

Still unknown: Whether Ravi's marriage continued or ended

Still unknown: Whether the same approach would help Arjun
